title: [correctness] useEffect overwrites in-progress input on conversation switch
description: useEffect(() => { setInput(persistedText) }, [persistedText]) fires whenever conversationId changes, overwriting any text the user has started typing before the async state update completes.
fix_direction: Remove the useEffect. Use lazy state initializer: useState(() => persistedText). Reset on conversationId change via key prop or empty-guard.

context.suggested_fix: const [input, setInput] = useState(() => persistedText)
context.notes: Race window between user input and batched state update. Severity: data loss on conversation switch.

title: [correctness] clearDraft called before send confirmation creates data loss on network failure
description: clearDraft() is called optimistically at send time. If the send fails (network error, rate limit), the draft is already gone from localStorage.
fix_direction: Move clearDraft() to the success callback of the send operation, or keep a pre-send text reference to restore on failure.

context.suggested_fix: Move clearDraft() to send success handler
context.notes: On send failure, users cannot recover their composed message.

title: [correctness] onOpenKnowledgePanel button always rendered when prop is undefined
description: BookmarkPlus button renders unconditionally. When onOpenKnowledgePanel is undefined, clicking it calls undefined(). Inconsistent with Trash2/Copy which have conditional render guards.
fix_direction: Wrap in conditional: {onOpenKnowledgePanel && <button onClick={onOpenKnowledgePanel} ...>}

context.suggested_fix: {onOpenKnowledgePanel && <button onClick={onOpenKnowledgePanel} aria-label='attach context' ...>}
context.notes: Dead/misleading UI element in contexts without knowledge panel.

title: [performance] persist() called synchronously on every keystroke
description: localStorage.setItem called synchronously on every keypress via onInputChange handler. Blocks main thread; measurable latency on lower-end hardware for long drafts.
fix_direction: Debounce persist with 350ms trailing delay. Flush before send to ensure final value is saved.

context.suggested_fix: const debouncedPersist = useMemo(() => debounce(persist, 350), [persist])
context.notes: Typing lag risk especially for documents > 10KB.

title: [performance] onInputChange inline arrow recreated on every render
description: Inline arrow (v) => { setInput(v); persist(v) } is a new reference on each ChatArea render, defeating ChatAreaComposer memoization and causing unnecessary re-renders.
fix_direction: Wrap in useCallback with [debouncedPersist] dependency after PERF-001 fix.

context.suggested_fix: const handleInputChange = useCallback((v) => { setInput(v); debouncedPersist(v) }, [debouncedPersist])
context.notes: Pairs with PERF-001 fix.

title: [architecture] Draft persistence logic mixed into ChatArea UI component
description: useDraftCache consumed directly in ChatArea couples persistence concern to UI layer. Draft lifecycle (when to persist, when to clear) scattered through ChatArea's render logic.
fix_direction: Wrap in ChatAreaViewModel hook or move draft orchestration into useAppShellViewModel.

context.suggested_fix: Extract to useChatAreaViewModel()
context.notes: Makes ChatArea harder to test in isolation.

title: [architecture] 4-level prop chain for onOpenKnowledgePanel
description: onOpenKnowledgePanel threaded through 4 layers: useAppShellViewModel → ChatSidebar → ChatArea → ChatAreaComposer. Adding new cross-cutting actions requires touching all 4 files.
fix_direction: Use a PanelContext that ChatAreaComposer consumes directly, bypassing the prop chain.

context.suggested_fix: const { togglePanel } = usePanelContext(); // used directly in ChatAreaComposer
context.notes: Impact radius: 4 files. Brittle to component tree refactors.

title: [architecture] ChatArea is a 1,269-line god component
description: ChatArea handles streaming, draft persistence, mode switching, tool use, selection, and rendering. Phase 1 additions make decomposition more urgent.
fix_direction: Decompose into ChatAreaViewModel hook + focused sub-components (ChatAreaToolbar, ChatAreaSendHandler).

context.suggested_fix: Extract ChatAreaViewModel, ChatAreaToolbar, ChatAreaSendHandler
context.notes: Pre-existing but worsened by Phase 1 additions.

title: [architecture] useDraftCache couples storage format to hook interface
description: Hook hardcodes localStorage and JSON format. Changing storage layer (e.g., IndexedDB for larger drafts) requires rewriting the hook interface.
fix_direction: Introduce StorageAdapter interface. Hook depends on interface, not implementation.

context.suggested_fix: interface DraftStorageAdapter { get(key): string | null; set(key, value): void; remove(key): void }
context.notes: Low immediate impact; becomes problematic as draft sizes grow.

title: [maintainability] ChatArea.tsx at 1,269 lines exceeds maintainable size
description: Phase 1 added ~50 lines. File was already at maintainability limit. Every change requires reading the entire file to avoid regression.
fix_direction: Priority decomposition: extract ChatAreaViewModel, ChatAreaToolbar, ChatAreaSendHandler.

context.suggested_fix: Multi-phase decomposition
context.notes: Pre-existing but Phase 1 worsened it.

title: [maintainability] localStorage key prefix 'niko.draft:' is a magic string
description: Key prefix hardcoded inline. Not exported for other modules to enumerate/clear draft keys. Key name drift risk.
fix_direction: Export const DRAFT_KEY_PREFIX = 'niko.draft:' from useDraftCache.ts

context.suggested_fix: export const DRAFT_KEY_PREFIX = 'niko.draft:'
context.notes: Pre-existing but actionable.

title: [maintainability] New toolbar buttons missing focus-visible classes unlike all other interactive elements
description: The 3 new toolbar buttons (BookmarkPlus, Trash2, Copy) added in TASK-002 lack focus-visible:ring-2 classes that TASK-005/006 added to all other interactive elements. Keyboard navigation inconsistency.
fix_direction: Add focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50 to all 3 new buttons.

context.suggested_fix: Add to className of BookmarkPlus, Trash2, Copy buttons
context.notes: Keyboard users get no focus indicator on these buttons.

title: [maintainability] globals.css composer token block lacks section boundary
description: New token block has one comment but is not visually separated from sidebar tokens above. As globals.css grows, locating token groups becomes harder.
fix_direction: Add blank line before and after the new block, consistent with other token group formatting.

context.suggested_fix: Add blank lines around the 6-line composer token block
context.notes: Minor but reinforces maintainability of the growing globals.css.

title: [maintainability] ChatArea draft lifecycle undocumented in-code
description: Contract between ChatArea and useDraftCache (when to persist, when to clear, what happens on conversationId change) not documented. Future maintainers must trace the entire component to understand.
fix_direction: Add brief contract comment above the useDraftCache line describing the 3 lifecycle moments.

context.suggested_fix: // Draft lifecycle: restore on mount, persist on keystroke (debounced), clear on send
context.notes: High risk of introducing CORR-001-class bugs without this documentation.

title: [best-practices] useEffect for syncing state from props is a React anti-pattern
description: React docs explicitly discourage useEffect to sync derived state from props. Creates render cycle: render → effect fires → setState → re-render. Root of CORR-001.
fix_direction: Use lazy state initializer: useState(() => persistedText) and key prop pattern for conversation reset.

context.suggested_fix: Remove useEffect; use useState(() => persistedText) + key={conversationId}
context.notes: Idiomatic React pattern. Resolves CORR-001 as a byproduct.

title: [best-practices] No visual feedback after clipboard copy action
description: Copy button provides no visual feedback after successful copy. Standard practice is to show a checkmark or brief toast. Users have no confirmation the action completed.
fix_direction: Add transient copied state: flip to true on success, revert after 1.5s. Show CheckIcon when copied.

context.suggested_fix: const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false); show CheckIcon for 1.5s on success
context.notes: Common UX pattern for clipboard actions.

title: [best-practices] clearDraft called unconditionally on send even when no draft exists
description: clearDraft() runs on every send, triggering localStorage.removeItem even when there is no draft. Unnecessary side effect on every send action.
fix_direction: Guard with: if (persistedText) clearDraft()

context.suggested_fix: if (persistedText) clearDraft()
context.notes: Functionally safe but represents unnecessary mutation.

title: [best-practices] focus-visible ring on non-interactive div in AppContextFooter
description: TASK-005 added focus-visible:ring-2 to AppContextFooter's outer div. Divs without tabIndex are not focusable — these classes are dead code and misleading to future developers.
fix_direction: Remove focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50 from the div.

context.suggested_fix: <div className="shell-text-compact px-4 py-1 text-gray-400 dark:text-dark-text-secondary border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-dark-border">
context.notes: One-line fix. Risk: future dev adds tabIndex thinking the ring is intentional.

title: [best-practices] Trash2 button appears/disappears without animation causing toolbar layout shift
description: Trash2 button pops in/out of existence as user types first character or deletes last. Creates jarring layout shift in the composer toolbar.
fix_direction: Render always but control visibility with opacity/pointer-events transition instead of conditional mount.

context.suggested_fix: Render with className={`... ${!input.length ? 'opacity-0 pointer-events-none' : ''}`}
context.notes: User experience issue on every first/last keystroke.

title: [best-practices] BookmarkPlus button missing disabled state for unavailable contexts
description: Button is always active with no disabled state. No visual affordance for unavailability. Ties into CORR-003 (should be conditionally rendered).
fix_direction: Combine with CORR-003 fix: conditionally render OR show disabled state when onOpenKnowledgePanel is undefined.

context.suggested_fix: disabled={!onOpenKnowledgePanel} with appropriate disabled styles
context.notes: Pairs with CORR-003 fix.

title: [best-practices] --composer-focus-ring token missing dark mode override
description: TASK-001 added --composer-focus-ring to :root with light mode value. .dark block has no override. Future components consuming this token will get incorrect dark mode color.
fix_direction: Add to .dark block: --composer-focus-ring: rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.5); (violet-400 at 50%)

context.suggested_fix: Add --composer-focus-ring: rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.5); to .dark block
context.notes: Token not yet consumed — no immediate user impact, but a future trap.

title: [correctness] Clipboard writeText called without runtime API availability check
description: navigator.clipboard.writeText called with .catch(() => {}) silencing failures. Doesn't guard against navigator.clipboard being undefined in non-HTTPS or unsupported environments.
fix_direction: Guard with if (navigator.clipboard) before calling. Show success/failure feedback.

context.suggested_fix: if (navigator.clipboard) { navigator.clipboard.writeText(content).catch(() => {}) }
context.notes: Silent failure gives no user feedback on copy.

title: [correctness] persistedText initial state ignores conversationId changes after mount
description: useState initializer only runs on mount. Draft restoration after conversationId change depends on the useEffect (CORR-001). Removing CORR-001's useEffect without a replacement breaks restoration.
fix_direction: Handle in useDraftCache with stable reload function, or use key={currentConversationId} on parent to remount.

context.suggested_fix: key={currentConversationId} on the component containing ChatArea's input state
context.notes: Depends on CORR-001 fix approach.

title: [correctness] useDraftCache TTL checked on load only, not on persist
description: 24h TTL validated only when loading a draft. If tab stays open across TTL boundary, persist() continues writing into an expired entry without refreshing the timestamp.
fix_direction: Refresh TTL metadata timestamp on every persist call.

context.suggested_fix: On persist: update savedAt to Date.now() in the stored object
context.notes: Pre-existing design choice; low urgency.

title: [correctness] Snapshot tests don't validate focus-visible interactive states
description: Snapshot tests added in Phase 1 capture static rendering but don't verify that focus-visible ring changes from TASK-005 apply correctly via keyboard navigation.
fix_direction: Add keyboard focus simulation tests: userEvent.tab() + expect(button).toHaveClass('focus-visible:ring-2')

context.suggested_fix: userEvent.tab(); expect(element).toHaveFocus()
context.notes: Focus ring behavior not tested through snapshot approach.

title: [security] localStorage draft content not size-bounded
description: No maximum size check before writing to localStorage. Very long drafts could push toward browser localStorage limits (5-10MB per origin), causing QuotaExceededError.
fix_direction: Add size check: skip/truncate persist if text exceeds threshold (e.g., 50KB). Catch QuotaExceededError.

context.suggested_fix: try { localStorage.setItem(...) } catch(e) { /* quota exceeded, skip */ }
context.notes: Also add try/catch around all localStorage calls.

title: [security] Clipboard receives AI-generated content without sanitization note
description: lastAssistantContent is AI-generated text written directly to clipboard. Acceptable for desktop Electron context, but assumption should be documented.
fix_direction: Add comment documenting the security assumption. No code change needed for current deployment.

context.suggested_fix: // safe in Electron desktop context; content is AI-generated prose
context.notes: Low risk currently; document assumption for future web deployment.

title: [security] Draft key uses conversationId without format validation
description: localStorage key uses conversationId verbatim. If id contains special characters or is user-controlled, key could collide with other entries. UUID format assumed but not enforced.
fix_direction: Validate conversationId format before using as key, or encode it with encodeURIComponent.

context.suggested_fix: const safeId = encodeURIComponent(conversationId)
context.notes: Low risk given UUID assumption; validate to make explicit.

title: [performance] useDraftCache reads localStorage on every conversationId change without debounce
description: Rapid conversation switching triggers a localStorage read + JSON.parse on each change. Minor hit during search/navigation through conversation history.
fix_direction: Add 50ms debounce on conversationId change effect to batch rapid switches.

context.suggested_fix: Debounce the useEffect that reads from localStorage
context.notes: Minor optimization; useful for UX responsiveness during list navigation.

title: [performance] useLatestAssistantMessageContent re-evaluates on every streaming token
description: Selector runs on every message update including streaming tokens, potentially causing ChatAreaComposer re-renders during active AI response streaming.
fix_direction: Memoize the selector or only pass lastAssistantContent when streaming is idle.

context.suggested_fix: Pass lastAssistantContent only when streamPhase === 'idle'
context.notes: Extra re-renders during streaming; may cause visible jank.

title: [performance] StoryBiblePanel snapshot captures hundreds of DOM nodes
description: Full container snapshot of StoryBiblePanel creates large .snap file and slow serialization. Snapshot tests that large components are anti-pattern.
fix_direction: Snapshot only the section header element being tested, not the full component.

context.suggested_fix: expect(queryByText('Characters')).toMatchSnapshot() instead of full container
context.notes: Large snapshots slow CI and create maintenance burden.

title: [performance] localStorage.clear() in test beforeEach runs for unrelated tests
description: Global localStorage.clear() in beforeEach of ChatArea.test.tsx runs for every test including those that don't use drafts. Minor overhead.
fix_direction: Scope cleanup to only tests that use draft functionality.

context.suggested_fix: Move localStorage.clear() to beforeEach within the draft-related describe block
context.notes: Negligible in test environments; good hygiene.

title: [architecture] ChatAreaComposer toolbar mixes unrelated feature concerns
description: Toolbar hosts knowledge attachment (BookmarkPlus), draft management (Trash2), and conversation history (Copy) with no architectural grouping or ownership model. Will grow unbounded.
fix_direction: Define toolbar slot sections (context-actions, draft-actions, history-actions) with explicit ownership.

context.suggested_fix: Structured toolbar sections with defined ownership per concern
context.notes: Design-level issue; defer to next architecture phase.

title: [architecture] ChatAreaModeControls simplification removed extension points
description: TASK-003 removed showAdvanced, onSetChatMode, and advanced section. If future modes need per-mode sub-settings, the extension mechanism no longer exists.
fix_direction: Document the intentional removal in the codebase. Add deferred item to roadmap.

context.suggested_fix: Comment: // Intentionally simplified in P1; re-add advanced section if needed
context.notes: Correct simplification; just needs documentation.

title: [architecture] Full-container snapshot tests create coupling to rendering details
description: Snapshot tests in Phase 1 capture full DOM structure including all CSS classes. Any unrelated UI change fails the snapshot, coupling test maintenance to irrelevant changes.
fix_direction: Replace full-container snapshots with targeted assertions on the specific behavior being tested.

context.suggested_fix: expect(button).toHaveClass('focus-visible:ring-2') instead of container snapshot
context.notes: Snapshot tests are obstacles, not safety nets, when applied to large components.

title: [architecture] Temporal coupling between persistedText and input state initialization
description: Initial state depends on persistedText from localStorage read. The initialization order creates implicit temporal coupling not documented anywhere.
fix_direction: Document the initialization contract or make it explicit with a loading state in useDraftCache.

context.suggested_fix: Add comment documenting the temporal dependency
context.notes: Subtle ordering dependency that causes bugs when violated.

title: [architecture] No abstraction layer between toolbar actions and their side effects
description: Toolbar button handlers defined inline directly calling browser APIs and prop callbacks. No unit-testable action layer exists.
fix_direction: Extract to useComposerActions hook taking props and returning stable handlers.

context.suggested_fix: const { copyLastReply, clearDraft, openKnowledge } = useComposerActions(props)
context.notes: Enables unit testing of toolbar logic without component mounting.

title: [maintainability] ChatAreaComposer props interface has grown to 13+ optional props
description: Phase 1 added 3 new optional props. Interface now has 13+ props making it unclear which are required vs optional. High cognitive load when consuming the component.
fix_direction: Group props by concern (required vs optional) or split into sub-interfaces.

context.suggested_fix: interface ChatAreaComposerRequiredProps {} & interface ChatAreaComposerOptionalProps {}
context.notes: Interface sprawl is a symptom of the toolbar concern mixing (ARC-005).

title: [maintainability] useDraftCache TTL value is a magic number
description: 24h TTL computed inline as a magic number. Configuration value should be a named constant.
fix_direction: Extract: const DRAFT_TTL_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000 // 24 hours

context.suggested_fix: const DRAFT_TTL_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
context.notes: Minor but accumulates as technical debt.

title: [maintainability] Focus-visible class string duplicated across 8+ component files
description: TASK-005/006 copy-pasted focus ring class string into 8+ files. Any change to the focus ring style requires updating every occurrence individually.
fix_direction: Extract to shared Tailwind @apply class in globals.css or CVA variant constant.

context.suggested_fix: @layer components { .focus-ring { @apply focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50; } }
context.notes: High duplication; inconsistency risk when updating focus style.

title: [maintainability] ChatAreaModeControls simplification not marked as intentional in code
description: Removal of showAdvanced, onSetChatMode, and advanced section was intentional scope reduction. Without a comment, future devs may re-add the removed infrastructure.
fix_direction: Add a brief comment: // Intentionally simplified to presets-only; advanced mode removed in P1 UX simplification

context.suggested_fix: Comment at top of file documenting intentional simplification
context.notes: Risk of reverting intentional design decision without documentation.

title: [maintainability] Test assertions query by aria-label strings that can drift
description: Tests query by aria-label string 'attach context'. If the label changes, test fails with confusing error rather than a clear signal.
fix_direction: Export label strings as constants from the component file and import in tests.

context.suggested_fix: export const ATTACH_CONTEXT_LABEL = 'attach context' — import in tests
context.notes: Common pattern for reducing test maintenance friction.

title: [maintainability] StoryBiblePanel snapshot too large to be maintainable
description: Snapshot test renders full component creating a large .snap file. Any unrelated change to StoryBiblePanel fails the snapshot.
fix_direction: Replace full snapshot with targeted header text/class assertions.

context.suggested_fix: Test specific header text/class instead of full container
context.notes: Pairs with ARC-007.

title: [maintainability] AppContextFooter has no test coverage
description: AppContextFooter was modified in TASK-005 but has no test file. The incorrectly added focus-visible classes (BP-004) went undetected because there were no tests.
fix_direction: Add AppContextFooter.test.tsx: renders null when empty, renders content, div lacks tabIndex.

context.suggested_fix: Create src/components/AppContextFooter.test.tsx with smoke + BP-004 regression test
context.notes: Missing test coverage directly caused BP-004 to be undetected.

title: [maintainability] Sidebar snapshot will break on every navigation item change
description: Sidebar snapshot captures full navigation tree. Adding/removing nav items will fail the snapshot, making it a merge conflict magnet.
fix_direction: Replace with targeted assertions on the specific focus-visible behavior TASK-005 introduced.

context.suggested_fix: Test focus ring application directly: userEvent.tab(); expect(navButton).toHaveFocus()
context.notes: Snapshot tests on navigation lists have very short useful lifespans.

title: [maintainability] clearDraft and persist hook return types not explicitly typed
description: useDraftCache return type is inferred, not declared. Explicit types aid IDE hover documentation and catch interface changes at the call site.
fix_direction: Add explicit return type declaration to useDraftCache.

context.suggested_fix: ): { persistedText: string; persist: (text: string) => void; clearDraft: () => void }
context.notes: Minor TypeScript hygiene improvement.

title: [maintainability] ChatArea.test.tsx stale test cleanup undocumented
description: TASK-007 fixed 5 pre-existing test failures in ChatArea.test.tsx but the nature of each fix is not documented. Future devs may re-introduce the removed test cases.
fix_direction: Add comment block noting which tests were removed and why (reference TASK-007 commit).

context.suggested_fix: // Removed tests: [list of removed test descriptions] — TASK-007
context.notes: Without documentation, removed tests invite re-introduction.

title: [maintainability] Section header normalization may be incomplete across all knowledge tabs
description: TASK-004 normalized section headers in 3 files. Other knowledge tabs (EventTab, ThemeTab, etc.) may still use old styles if they exist.
fix_direction: Audit all knowledge tab components for section header class consistency.

context.suggested_fix: grep for old section header class pattern across all knowledge/* files
context.notes: Visual inconsistency risk if missed tabs exist.

title: [best-practices] Missing aria-live region for draft-restored notification
description: When a draft is restored on conversation switch, there is no accessible announcement. Screen reader users have no way to know their previous draft was loaded.
fix_direction: Add aria-live='polite' region that announces 'Draft restored' when persistedText is loaded.

context.suggested_fix: {draftRestored ? 'Draft restored' : ''}
context.notes: Accessibility gap for screen reader users.

title: [best-practices] Copy button missing aria-pressed state for copy confirmation
description: After copy, button provides no state change signal to assistive technologies. aria-pressed or a status announcement would confirm the copy action to screen readers.
fix_direction: Add aria-pressed={copied} and update aria-label to 'copied!' after success for 1.5s.

context.suggested_fix: aria-pressed={copied} aria-label={copied ? 'copied!' : 'copy last reply'}
context.notes: Pairs with BP-002 (visual copy feedback).

title: [best-practices] QuickPanel search input missing autocomplete=off
description: Search inputs should have autocomplete='off' to prevent browser autofill from interfering with quick-switch functionality.
fix_direction: Add autocomplete='off' to QuickPanel search input.

context.suggested_fix: autocomplete='off'
context.notes: Pre-existing; minor browser autofill UX issue.

title: [best-practices] AiToolbar disabled state missing aria-disabled attribute
description: TASK-006 added disabled:cursor-not-allowed CSS. HTML disabled attribute present but aria-disabled not explicitly set. Minor a11y gap.
fix_direction: Add aria-disabled={true} to match HTML disabled for maximum AT compatibility.

context.suggested_fix: aria-disabled={isDisabled}
context.notes: Most screen readers handle HTML disabled correctly; this is belt-and-suspenders.

title: [best-practices] MessageBubble focus rings untested through keyboard navigation
description: TASK-006 added focus rings to 4 MessageBubble buttons but no test verifies keyboard navigation through them (tab order, focus management after action).
fix_direction: Add keyboard navigation tests for MessageBubble action buttons.

context.suggested_fix: userEvent.tab() through MessageBubble and verify focus management
context.notes: Focus rings present but untested.

title: [best-practices] ChatSidebar ComponentProps spread exposes all ChatArea props
description: chatAreaProps typed as ComponentProps<typeof ChatArea> and spread to ChatArea. Adding props to ChatArea automatically exposes them through ChatSidebar's interface.
fix_direction: Define explicit ChatSidebarProps interface with only the props consumers need to configure.

context.suggested_fix: Pick specific props instead of ComponentProps spread
context.notes: Pre-existing; became more impactful as ChatArea grows.

title: [best-practices] Sidebar active state uses raw palette classes instead of semantic tokens
description: TASK-005 active state highlight uses bg-primary-50 dark:bg-primary-900/20 — raw Tailwind values. Changing the app's active color requires updating every file that uses these classes.
fix_direction: Define --color-active-bg semantic token in globals.css and use via arbitrary values.

context.suggested_fix: bg-[var(--color-active-bg)] text-[var(--color-active-text)]
context.notes: Part of broader token system; defer to future design system phase.

title: [best-practices] Snapshot tests lack update instructions in test file
description: Snapshot tests added in TASK-008 will fail after legitimate UI changes. No comment or documentation about how to update snapshots intentionally.
fix_direction: Add comment: // Update snapshots with: pnpm test -- --update-snapshots

context.suggested_fix: // To update: pnpm test -- --update-snapshots
context.notes: Reduces confusion when snapshots legitimately need updating.

title: [best-practices] BookmarkPlus icon semantic mismatch with knowledge panel action
description: BookmarkPlus is a 'save to bookmarks' icon. Intended action is opening the knowledge/context panel. Creates semantic disconnect for users familiar with standard iconography.
fix_direction: Consider Library, Database, or StickyNote (Lucide) icon for knowledge-related actions.

context.suggested_fix: <Library size={15} /> or <Database size={15} />
context.notes: UX improvement; non-blocking.

title: [best-practices] onOpenKnowledgePanel naming doesn't match toggle behavior
description: Prop named onOpenKnowledgePanel but implementation toggles (opens AND closes). Misleading name creates maintenance confusion.
fix_direction: Rename to onToggleKnowledgePanel throughout the prop chain (4 files).

context.suggested_fix: Rename prop in useAppShellViewModel, ChatArea, and ChatAreaComposer
context.notes: Trivial rename; high clarity improvement.

title: [best-practices] ChatAreaModeControls tests lack negative assertions for removed functionality
description: Test file updated in TASK-003 but no tests explicitly verify the advanced section is gone. If accidentally re-added, tests won't catch it.
fix_direction: Add: expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /show less|show advanced/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument()

context.suggested_fix: Add negative assertion for removed functionality
context.notes: Regression guard for intentional simplification.

title: [performance] PERF-006 transition-colors on all toolbar buttons adds GPU layers
description: All toolbar buttons use transition-colors which triggers GPU compositing on hover. With 5+ buttons, each hover creates a layer promotion. Minor impact on modern hardware.
fix_direction: Group buttons in a single transition container if GPU profiling shows issues.

context.suggested_fix: Acceptable for desktop app; monitor if hover jank is reported
context.notes: Low priority; only action if GPU profiling confirms impact.

title: [best-practices] Trash2 aria-hidden on focusable interactive button
description: When input is empty, the Trash2 clear-draft button has aria-hidden=true but remains keyboard-focusable (no tabIndex=-1 applied). ARIA spec forbids aria-hidden on interactive elements still in tab order — keyboard users can focus a control their screen reader cannot describe. WCAG 2.1 SC 1.3.1 violation.
fix_direction: Replace aria-hidden with tabIndex={input.length === 0 ? -1 : undefined} and remove aria-hidden. Keep opacity-0 pointer-events-none for visual hiding. Or conditionally render the button only when input is non-empty.

context.suggested_fix: Remove aria-hidden attribute; add tabIndex={input.length === 0 ? -1 : undefined}
context.notes: Introduced in TASK-001 gap-fix when changing Trash2 from conditional mount to always-rendered opacity transition. pointer-events-none does not remove from tab order.

title: [best-practices] Copy success feedback not announced to screen readers
description: The copy button transitions aria-label from "copy last reply" to "copied!" on success, but changing aria-label in place does not reliably trigger announcements in NVDA/VoiceOver. WCAG 2.1 SC 4.1.3 requires status changes to be programmatically determinable without requiring focus.
fix_direction: Add a visually-hidden aria-live="polite" status region adjacent to the copy button. Push the "Copied!" string into it on copy success. The button aria-label can remain static.

context.suggested_fix: Add {copied ? "Copied!" : ""} adjacent to the copy button
context.notes: Introduced in TASK-001 gap-fix copy feedback state addition. aria-label change on button click does not reliably trigger screen reader announcement.

title: [UAT] Theme switching only affects a few buttons, not the full UI

title: [UAT] Send button mouse click not working — only keyboard send works

resolution: onMouseDown workaround bypasses WebView2 click event interception
